verdict.rationale: Pika's own app list includes 'Swap Anything: Swap anything in your clip', which covers replacing an element inside an existing video. 'Add Elements' (insert or erase any item in your shot) and Pikadditions add related element-level video editing. The swap/remove/restyle claim is documented for images only, and all evidence is one-line vendor descriptions. Missing for 10: explicit element restyling within video, evidence that the rest of the frame stays intact, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
